protocol.selection: Maximum conditional training likelihood within each fixed specification; every start/convergence status retained
protocol.measurement: Same existing causal EMA/gap construction as prior forecast study; scalar next-difference EMA or next raw return, lagged state and observed flow; no structural VAR
protocol.uncertainty: Chronological whole-date forecasts; few dates, exploratory intervals; no regular chi-square switching LR reference
protocol.scope: Retrospective existing-data study, not new learning-agent experiment

provenance.filter_scope: Uses exact previously reported causal EMA construction; filters reset at data gaps, regressions/lags do not cross UTC dates. EMA itself continues across contiguous UTC dates in this prior construction.
